jsonld.name: F1 Maintenance & Repair
jsonld.description: Licensed, family owned plumbing company in Miami, FL. Water heaters, drain cleaning, leak repair and plumbing fixture installation.

parrafo.es: F1 Maintenance & Repair es una empresa familiar de Miami que atiende calentadores de agua, desagues tapados, fugas y arreglos de plomeria en general. Trabajo limpio, explicado claro, sin inflar el presupuesto.
parrafo.en: F1 Maintenance & Repair is a family owned Miami company handling water heaters, clogged drains, leaks and general plumbing repair. Clean work, explained clearly, no padded estimates.

hero.imagen_alt: Calentador de agua Rheem recien instalado por F1 Maintenance & Repair

parrafo_1.es: F1 Maintenance & Repair atiende plomeria residencial en Miami: calentadores de agua, desagues tapados, fugas de emergencia y arreglos de tuberia. El mismo equipo llega, diagnostica y resuelve, sin subcontratar a desconocidos.
parrafo_1.en: F1 Maintenance & Repair handles residential plumbing across Miami: water heaters, clogged drains, emergency leaks and pipe repair. The same crew shows up, diagnoses and fixes it, no subcontracting to strangers.

parrafo_2.es: Usan equipo de camara para localizar obstrucciones en la linea de desague antes de abrir pared o piso, asi el cliente paga por el arreglo exacto y no por adivinar.
parrafo_2.en: They use sewer camera equipment to pinpoint a clogged line before opening a wall or floor, so the customer pays for the exact fix instead of a guess.

texto.es: Nos cuentas el problema: fuga, desague tapado, calentador sin agua caliente. Coordinamos el horario el mismo dia cuando es posible.
texto.en: Tell us the problem: a leak, a clogged drain, a water heater with no hot water. We coordinate same day scheduling when possible.

texto.es: Revisamos el problema real antes de cotizar, con camara de inspeccion cuando el caso lo requiere, para no adivinar.
texto.en: We check the real problem before quoting, using sewer camera equipment when the job calls for it, instead of guessing.

texto.es: Reparamos, instalamos o reemplazamos la pieza que haga falta: calentador, valvula, tramo de tuberia o linea de desague.
texto.en: We repair, install or replace whatever the job needs: a water heater, a valve, a section of pipe or a drain line.

titulo.en: Clean area on the way out

texto.es: Dejamos el espacio de trabajo limpio y te explicamos que se hizo, sin letras pequenas.
texto.en: We leave the work area clean and walk you through what was done, no fine print.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza segun el alcance real. Llama y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on its real scope. Call and we will walk you through it, no obligation.

pie.es: No ves tu problema en la lista? Llama igual: si es plomeria, probablemente lo resolvemos.
pie.en: Do not see your problem on this list? Call anyway: if it is plumbing, we likely handle it.

texto.es: Instalacion y reparacion de calentadores de tanque y sin tanque. Valvulas, conexiones de gas y agua revisadas antes de cerrar el trabajo.
texto.en: Installation and repair of tank and tankless water heaters. Valves, gas and water connections checked before the job is closed.

texto.es: Limpieza con maquina de cable e inspeccion por camara para ubicar la obstruccion exacta antes de abrir piso o pared.
texto.en: Cable machine cleaning and camera inspection to locate the exact blockage before opening a floor or wall.

texto.es: Reparacion de fugas, valvulas de paso y llaves de emergencia que dejan de funcionar justo cuando mas se necesitan.
texto.en: Repair of leaks, shut off valves and emergency valves that stop working right when you need them most.

texto.es: Instalacion de llaves de bano y cocina, filtros y suavizadores de agua, con tuberia nueva cuando el caso lo pide.
texto.en: Installation of bathroom and kitchen faucets, filters and water softeners, with new pipe runs when the job calls for it.

items.quote: It was 10 pm on a Friday night and we had finally put our newborn to bed when we realized our bedroom floor was wet. F1 came out and fixed the leak fast, no drama.
I have had a lot of trouble finding plumbers who actually listen and care to solve the issue without just thinking about money. F1 were very honest, very reliable.
Replaced emergency shut off valve to the house that broke and garden hose nozzle valve. Excellent job.
